name: FALLETTE'S DEATH
source:
You are “Fallette”, the miserable blood stain. Your mind drifts as you struggle to create the gallery.

[From [url=https://slitherbop.itch.io/fallettes-death]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是“法莱特”，一摊悲惨的血迹。在苦苦打造画廊的过程中，你的思绪渐渐飘远。

[摘自[url=https://slitherbop.itch.io/fallettes-death]itch.io[/url]]
